title: Cosmic Turtle and Chick
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large green sea turtle with a cosmic shell carrying a glowing tree of swirling blue galaxies and floating ghost-like houses. In the foreground, an angry yellow chick wearing a medallion stands inside an ornate circular frame beside a smiling purple ghost and a small robot holding a lantern, set against rolling green hills, a winding path with two silhouetted figures, an ocean with coral, and a large red sun.
prompt: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene with a giant green sea turtle swimming in the ocean, its shell filled with colorful coral and a large glowing tree growing from its back with swirling blue galaxy portals and floating ghost houses in its branches. In the foreground a fierce yellow chick with an angry expression wears a purple medallion and stands inside a decorative circular frame next to a friendly purple ghost and a small robot with a lantern, set on rolling green hills with a winding path where two silhouetted figures walk toward the water, a bright red sun setting over the ocean under a purple sky.
